Preconditions: Page has at least 3 sections in the designer
Steps:
[ACT] [MANUAL] Not reliably automatable with the current MCP browser toolset: this reorder uses Angular CDK Drag & Drop (@angular/cdk/drag-drop), pointer-events-based (no HTML5 draggable=true anywhere). [ASSERT] Verify the sections reorder in the left panel
[ASSERT] Verify the live preview updates to reflect the new section order
[ACT] Save the page
[ACT] Reopen the page and verify the order is persisted
